Distinguish component checks, runtime-contract passes and full-fixture passes. External rustc/native oracle evidence is separately labeled and never interpreter execution. Unsupported runtime behavior remains a blocker.

## Plan updates

Link registry/claim/history updates and any docs/tasks.json or implementation-state changes. State the acceptance scope; a merged slice does not complete its whole track or card. Dependency-blocked candidates and unexecuted requirements stay pending.
